L0: # Build a payments page
L1: 
L2: Create a payments page with prebuilt UIs using the Checkout Sessions API.
L3: 
L4: Read this page in your terminal: [install the Stripe CLI](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/install) (v1.43.3+) and run `stripe docs`. [Reference](https://docs.stripe.com/cli/docs)
L5: ## Start here: Integrate with Stripe using skills and plugins
L6: 
L7: Stripe provides skills and plugins for agents to build faster and more accurately. See [Agent skills](https://docs.stripe.com/skills.md) for more information.
L8: 
L9: **Quickstart**: Install the Stripe CLI with `npm install -g @stripe/cli` and run `stripe agent setup`.
L10: ## Accept payments on your website
L11: 
L12: Accept one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods.
L13: [Start building your checkout integration](https://docs.stripe.com/checkout/quickstart.md)
L14: ## Stripe Checkout
L15: You can use three payment UIs with the Checkout Sessions API. The following images highlight which parts of the checkout UI Stripe hosts for each option. To build and manage these integrations, use [Checkout studio](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout-studio.md).
L16: ![Full page](https://b.stripecdn.com/docs-statics-srv/assets/checkout-hosted-hover.6ee5a154986ffc216c034a47b7b0d65e.png)
L17: [Full page](https://docs.stripe.com/checkout/quickstart.md): Customers enter their payment details in a fully-featured payment page, either embedded on your site or via a redirect to a Stripe-hosted page.
L18: ![Embedded form](https://b.stripecdn.com/docs-statics-srv/assets/checkout-form-hover.31c41716c4857e5e01f77978530fc573.png)
L19: [Embedded form](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/how-checkout-works.md?payment-ui=checkout-form): Customers enter their payment details in an embedded form on your site without redirection.
L20: ![Elements](https://b.stripecdn.com/docs-statics-srv/assets/checkout-elements-hover.28148f5be39600e85ef4784ab9e873e7.png)

L32: ## Customize checkout
L33: 
L34: [Customize the look and feel](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/customization.md): Customize the appearance and behavior of the checkout flow.
L35: 
L36: [Collect additional information](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/collect-additional-info.md): Collect shipping details and other customer information during checkout.
L37: 
L38: [Collect taxes](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/taxes.md): Collect taxes for one-time payments in Stripe Checkout.
L39: [Dynamically update checkout](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/dynamic-updates.md): Make updates while your customer checks out.
L40: 
L41: [Extend checkout with custom components](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/custom-components.md): Add custom components to your payment form.
L42:

L44: ## Change when and how you collect payment
L45: 
L46: [Set up subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/subscriptions.md): Create a subscription with recurring payments for your customers.
L47: 
L48: [Set up future payments](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/save-and-reuse.md): Save your customers’ payment details to charge them later.
L49: [Save payment details during payment](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/save-during-payment.md): Accept a payment and save your customer’s payment details for future purchases.
